prerequisites: Exact firmware-owned profile, reference, vectors, schemas and consumer locks
Node 20 and Python 3 with the repository's pinned qualification dependencies

steps.action: Record repository base revisions, dirty source hashes, procedure digest, Node and Python versions.
steps.expect: The precise candidate and its first-channel and radio-handshake dependencies are identified.

steps.action: Run tools/verify_radio_validation.py from firmware, app and Workshop checkouts.
steps.expect: All three exact inventories, profile and dependency hashes agree; altered or incompatible pins fail.

steps.action: Run the app host qualification tools/check_radio_validation.py, including the owner Node test suite and omission controls.
steps.expect: Four actual synthetic AES-CCM flights, each loss, duplicate, malformed/tampered or stale packet, deadline and recovery adapter cases meet the profile. Actual EDHOC and target hardware remain outside the model.

steps.action: Retain test logs, measured coverage, source digests, failure attempts and linked retries.
steps.expect: All required automatic checks must pass; an unrun or interrupted case is incomplete.

required_evidence: Host test and control logs and coverage
physical_observations: None. The later C8.9 Workshop procedure requires matching integrated LINK and CORE builds, live protected radio adapters and real device observations.
